The claim prefix does not certify truth.

## Status boundary

- [ ] No complete proof or counterexample is claimed.
- [ ] This is a `RESOLUTION_CANDIDATE`; the full dependency and verification
      packet is explicitly identified above.

Every review and integration verdict applies to an exact source SHA. Later
changes to this PR are not automatically covered by an earlier verdict.
